# MAAC Animation Jaipur — Maya Academy of Advanced Creativity

## About
MAAC Jaipur (Maya Academy of Advanced Creativity) is Rajasthan's leading animation, VFX, and multimedia training institute. Established in 1998, we have 30+ years of excellence in creative education. Located at C-Scheme, Jaipur, Rajasthan, India.

## Key Facts
- Founded: 1998
- Location: 711-712, Ambition Tower, 7th Floor, C-Scheme, Jaipur, Rajasthan 302001, India
- Phone: +91-9829294037, +91-9929059559, +91-7300001589
- Email: maacanimationjaipur@gmail.com
- Website: https://www.maacanimationjaipur.com
- Placement Rate: 95%
- Rating: 4.9/5 (422+ Google reviews)
- Certifications: NSDC, Skill India, MESC
- Awards: FICCI BAF Awards 2024
- Opening Hours: Monday–Saturday, 9:00 AM – 7:00 PM

## Courses Offered

### Degree Programs
- B.Voc in 3D Animation & VFX (3 years, UGC-recognized)
- B.Voc in Gaming & Interactive Media (3 years)

### Diploma Programs
- AD3D Edge Plus (25 months) — Advanced 3D Animation
- D3D (18 months) — 3D Animation
- DAFX Plus (16 months) — Visual Effects
- DGDI (16 months) — Game Design & Development
- ADMD (12 months) — Digital Marketing & Design

### Short-Term Programs
- Animation & Filmmaking (12 months)
- Digital Content Creation (6 months)
- Graphic Design (3 months)
- Photography & Videography (3 months)

### Specialized Programs
- VFX Plus (12 months) — Advanced Visual Effects
- Broadcast Motion Graphics (8 months)
- Architectural Design Visualization (6 months)
- Design Viz Pro (4 months)

## Software Taught
Autodesk Maya, 3ds Max, ZBrush, Substance Painter, Nuke, After Effects, Premiere Pro, Blender, Unreal Engine 5, Houdini, Mari, Marvelous Designer, Arnold Renderer, V-Ray

## Career Opportunities
Graduates work at studios including DNEG, Prime Focus, MPC, Technicolor, Ubisoft, Rockstar Games, Sony Pictures, Netflix, Amazon Studios, Disney+ Hotstar. Average starting salary: ₹3–15 LPA.
